entities.summary: Yuri Nikolaevich Krylov was an ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Championship League for HC Dynamo Moscow. Internationally he played for the Soviet national team at the 1956 Winter Olympics, winning the gold medal. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1954.
